result_commit: The Git commit containing this directory; reported after commit/push.
signal: SV_raw = Var_t(abs(E)), denominator N; linear raw SV

geometry.source: X1 apparent lateral span x physical diameter ellipse
geometry.bands: physical axial thirds with frozen subpixel weights
geometry.tail: X1 rectangle at true physical bottom

analysis.moving_median: centered on original integer grid, min_periods=1; edge truncated; NaN ignored for baseline, invalid center stays NaN
analysis.spearman: Pearson of pairwise-valid average ranks; min 3 pairs
analysis.specificity: rho(0) - median rho at absolute lag 30 through 50, inclusive
analysis.peak: maximum signed rho; exact ties resolved by smallest absolute lag then smaller signed lag
analysis.zero_rank: competition rank: 1 + number of strictly greater rho values
analysis.partial: average ranks then OLS with intercept and indicated controls; Pearson of residuals; rank is re-computed in each pairwise-complete subset
analysis.partial_modes: raw plus residual signals and residual controls at 31/51/101

d128_q: Direct quantify_raw_sv replay from SHA-verified retained formal NPZ; never median-times-area
